name: Saint Lucy
history: A young Christian of Syracuse in Sicily who gave her dowry to the poor and was martyred under Diocletian. Her name means light, and her feast, near the darkest days of the year, is kept with candles, especially in Scandinavia. She is named in the Roman Canon.
meditation: Be a light in someone's darkness today.
prayer: Graciously hear us, O God of our salvation; that as we rejoice in the festivity of blessed Luciæ Vírginis tuæ, we may be instructed in the affections of a loving devotion. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
